item.title: Sounds like Doug Liman and Pete Davidson's Bitcoin biopic is being filmed in a hellish AI void
item.description: Pete Davidson and Casey Affleck are set to star in Killing Satoshi, while the role of "backgrounds and scenery" will be played by AI slop.

item.title: Uneasy Hollywood suddenly realizes it hasn't rebooted Charlie's Angels in a minute
item.description: Seven years after the last Charlie's Angels movie bombed in theaters, Sony is reportedly trying again.

item.title: Happy Valentine's Day: The Olympic Village has already run out of condoms
item.description: Athletes have reportedly had to resort to playing PlayStation to relax after burning through a meager 10,000 prophylactic supply.

item.title: Casey Wasserman agrees to sell his agency, but it shouldn’t have taken this long
item.description: After appearing in the latest batch of Epstein files, Wasserman is putting his company on the market, citing that “it’s not fair to the clients and partners we represent so vigorously and care so deeply about.”

item.title: Disney is extremely mad at China's new plagiarism machine
item.description: Disney has issued a cease-and-desist to the just-released Seedance 2.0, accusing it of "hijacking Disney's characters."

item.title: Even Emerald Fennell thinks her Zatanna script was too weird to be a superhero movie
item.description: "Nobody would have made that," the Wuthering Heights director said of her efforts at writing a film version of the DC Comics magician.
